interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps to physically slow traffic and reinforce the residential speed limit.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Marked crossings at intersections would provide pedestrians with designated safe areas to cross the street.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections or potential mid-block crossing points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lights to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Install a continuous paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe walking path.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with tactile warning strips at the intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install street lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at the nearest intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Prune low-hanging tree branches to a height of at least 8 feet to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential area.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add a center line or edge lines to better define the travel lanes and organize traffic flow.

interventions.title: Driveway Design Reinforcement
interventions.description: Ensure sidewalk pavement materials continue across driveways to visually prioritize pedestrians over turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or other measures to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Verge
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or grass verge between the sidewalk and the curb to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Use pavement markings to define narrower travel lanes, which can help reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to ensure visibility and safety during nighttime hours, as no luminaires are visible.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Driveways
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near driveway entrances to improve sightlines between exiting drivers and pedestrians on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing Markings
interventions.description: Add edge line markings to narrow the perceived travel lane, which naturally encourages slower driving speeds.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from the roadway.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk material and level across driveways to reinforce pedestrian priority and alert drivers to the crossing.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Tables
interventions.description: Install vertical deflection measures to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential street.

interventions.title: Install Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to increase the physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Driveway Awareness Markings
interventions.description: Use contrasting materials or paint to clearly define the sidewalk's priority across driveway crossings.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks to designate safe crossing locations for residents.

interventions.title: Driveway Design Standards
interventions.description: Implement narrower curb cuts or continuous sidewalk materials across driveways to reinforce pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Patch or replace cracked sections of the concrete walkway to ensure a smooth, accessible surface.
